scope: Independent read-only audit of native HAL artifacts, recorded strict-link commands/object inputs, real reference-library provenance and existing QEMU Android-linker metadata smoke. No compilation, HAL device call, GPU execution or hardware test performed by this reviewer.

loader_smoke.scope: Real Android ARM linker/libc plus the new DSOs under QEMU Linux user-mode, not a booted Android system.
loader_smoke.gralloc_source_constructor_inspected: Initializes module metadata/callbacks, zeros state, initializes pthread mutex and sets ion_client=-1; no ion_open/device open in this constructor.
loader_smoke.constructor_limit: dlopen/dlclose execute applicable constructors/destructors; no blanket assertion that every dependency is side-effect-free.
loader_smoke.PIE_warning: unsupported flags DT_FLAGS_1=0x8000001 names the probe executable and remains visible in all5logs. NewHALs haveDF_1_NOW only, notPIE.

assessment: Both source-built HALs have a strict manual native reference link and a successful dynamic-load/metadata/close smoke in the recorded ARM32 Android-library environment. This closes the earlier standalone-object-only limitation for this reference experiment, without proving the full AOSP build graph or graphics/device operation.
limits: Link inputs are explicit API25 SDK Android7.1.1 reference ELFs plus pinned vendor libion, not a compiled Rockchip Android7.1.2 BSP or original board firmware.
Imported dynamic symbols remain normal DSO imports; strict link resolves their providers in the recorded reference set. This does not mean allsymbols are defined inside each HAL.
Probe versions/names are observed output, not expected-version assertions. Module methods, framebuffer/ioctl, buffer allocation/composition, ION/RGA/fences and GPU/HDMI behavior are untested.
No complete Android system, ramdisk, SD image, monitor integration, physical RK3229 boot or internal-storage preservation is established.
